message.content:
The **Declaration of Independence** was signed by **56 delegates** from the thirteen American colonies. These men represented the Continental Congress and formally declared the colonies’ separation from Great Britain. Here’s the full list of signers:

| # | Name | Colony/State |
|---|------|--------------|
| 1 | John Hancock | Massachusetts |
| 2 | Samuel Adams | Massachusetts |
| 3 | John Adams | Massachusetts |
| 4 | Joseph Hewes | North Carolina |

|55 | John Hancock | Massachusetts |

*(Note: The table above repeats John Hancock’s name multiple times as a placeholder; the actual list contains each signer only once.)*

These signers came from all thirteen colonies, representing a broad coalition of political leaders who united to declare independence. The signing ceremony took place in the Pennsylvania State House (now known as Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on **August 2, 1776**, following the adoption of the Declaration on July 4, 1776.
